title: What Happens When You Order on Zomato?
logline: From the tap on 'Place Order' to the knock on the door: payment, restaurant, rider matching, cooking, pickup, live tracking, delivery and payouts.

shots.title: What Happens When You Order Food on Zomato?
shots.scene: a cozy modern Indian living room in the evening, warm lamp light, a sofa with cushions
shots.action: the young woman sits on the sofa holding her smartphone and taps the screen with a smile, slow camera push in

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Ananya is hungry. She opens Zomato and orders a chicken biryani.
lines.tts: Ananya is hungry. She opens Zo-maato and orders a chicken biryani.

shots.label: Step 1 · You pay
shots.scene: a glowing golden padlock floating above streams of bright digital light lines on a deep blue background
shots.action: golden coins flow along the light lines into the padlock, which clicks shut with a soft sparkle

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: She pays online. The payment is checked and approved in a few seconds.

shots.label: Step 2 · Restaurant gets the order
shots.scene: a busy, clean restaurant kitchen with steel counters, steaming pots and a tablet on a stand
shots.action: the chef turns toward the tablet on the counter, reads it and taps it with one finger, nodding

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Zomato sends her order to the restaurant, Raju's Kitchen, on their tablet.
lines.tts: Zo-maato sends her order to the restaurant, Raju's Kitchen, on their tablet.

shots.scene: a busy, clean restaurant kitchen with steel counters and steaming pots
shots.action: the chef smiles at the camera, gives a big thumbs up and talks cheerfully

lines.speaker: raju
lines.text: One chicken biryani! Accepted. Ready in fifteen minutes!

shots.label: Step 3 · Zomato finds a rider
shots.scene: a stylized top-down animated map of an Indian city at dusk with roads glowing softly
shots.action: glowing rings ripple outward from one bright restaurant marker and reach several small glowing scooter dots

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Now Zomato looks for a delivery rider near the restaurant.
lines.tts: Now Zo-maato looks for a delivery rider near the restaurant.

shots.scene: a stylized top-down animated map of an Indian city at dusk with roads glowing softly
shots.action: one glowing scooter dot lights up brighter and a glowing path draws itself from it to the restaurant marker

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: It picks one based on distance, traffic and cooking time.

shots.scene: a busy Indian city street in the evening with shops and warm street lights
shots.action: the delivery rider sits on his parked scooter, looks at the phone mounted on the handlebar and taps it

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Arjun, a nearby rider, gets the order. He'll reach just as the food is ready.

shots.scene: a busy Indian city street in the evening with shops and warm street lights
shots.action: the delivery rider smiles, pulls down his helmet visor and starts the scooter, talking

lines.speaker: arjun
lines.text: Okay! Heading to the restaurant now!

shots.label: Step 4 · Food is cooked
shots.scene: a busy, clean restaurant kitchen with steel counters and a big pot of biryani
shots.action: the chef stirs the big pot of biryani with steam rising, then spoons it into a takeaway box and seals it

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Meanwhile, Chef Raju cooks the biryani, packs it and seals the box.

shots.label: Step 5 · Rider picks up the food
shots.scene: a restaurant pickup counter with warm lights
shots.action: the chef hands a sealed paper bag across the counter to the delivery rider, both smile and nod

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Arjun picks up the food and taps 'Picked up' in his app.

shots.label: Step 6 · Live tracking
shots.scene: an evening city road with warm street lights and light traffic
shots.action: the delivery rider rides his red scooter smoothly along the road, camera tracking alongside him

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: As he rides, his phone shares his location with Zomato.
lines.tts: As he rides, his phone shares his location with Zo-maato.

shots.scene: a cozy modern Indian living room in the evening, warm lamp light, a sofa with cushions
shots.action: the young woman on the sofa looks at her smartphone and smiles, the screen glowing on her face

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: So Ananya can watch him coming on a live map, with the arrival time.

shots.label: Step 7 · Food delivered
shots.scene: the front door of an apartment in a bright, clean corridor
shots.action: the delivery rider stands at the apartment door holding a paper bag, rings the bell and talks with a friendly smile

lines.speaker: arjun
lines.text: Hello! Your biryani from Raju's Kitchen.

shots.scene: the open front door of an apartment in a bright, clean corridor
shots.action: the young woman at the open door takes the paper bag from the delivery rider, both smile, she talks happily

lines.speaker: ananya
lines.text: Perfect timing! Thank you so much!

shots.label: Step 8 · Rating and payment
shots.scene: glowing golden coins floating above a soft blue background with three glowing streams
shots.action: the coins split into three glowing streams that float gently in different directions

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Then Ananya rates her food. Her money is shared between the restaurant, Arjun and Zomato.
lines.tts: Then Ananya rates her food. Her money is shared between the restaurant, Arjun and Zo-maato.

shots.scene: a cozy modern Indian living room in the evening, warm lamp light, a sofa with cushions
shots.action: the young woman sits on the sofa happily eating biryani from a takeaway box, slow camera pull out

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: And that's what happens every time you order food on Zomato!
lines.tts: And that's what happens every time you order food on Zo-maato!

claims.text: Restaurants receive and accept orders in a restaurant partner app, which shows preparation and delivery times.
Rider assignment is largely algorithmic and weighs distance, preparation time, traffic and rider availability.
Delivery platforms time rider assignment around food preparation time so riders don't wait (industry practice).
Customers can follow order status and, for many orders, the rider's live location on a map.

metadata.summary: From the tap on 'Place Order' to the knock on your door: payment, the restaurant's partner app, how a delivery partner gets matched, cooking and packing, pickup, live tracking, delivery and payouts. A simplified, animated explainer.
